styles.description: The Mandelbrot set's cardioid-and-bulb silhouette at the bar's centre, with its escape-time equipotential lines spreading outward to fill the bar as progress rises and rippling with time.

styles.name: julia-set
styles.description: Three filled Julia sets side by side — the basilica (c=−1), Douady's rabbit and the spiralling Siegel disk — each sharpening from a round blob into its true shape as progress raises its iteration depth; c trembles gently with time.

styles.name: sierpinski-triangle
styles.description: A row of Sierpinski triangles built from Pascal's triangle mod 2: each starts as a solid triangle and subdivides level by level, left to right, as progress rises; a chaos-game walker hops between vertices with time.

styles.name: koch-curve
styles.description: Koch curve laid along the bar: each middle third grows a triangular bump, again and again — progress rewrites the line left to right at each finer level (straight line → one bump → 4 → 16 → 64), and a spark runs along the finished curve with time

styles.name: barnsley-fern
styles.description: Barnsley's four-map IFS fern laid along the bar: the frond unfurls from its stem toward the tip as progress rises, with alternating leaflets, and sways with time.

styles.name: dragon-curve
styles.description: Heighway dragon by paper folding: four panels show the strip folded 2, 4, 6 and 8 times, each drawing itself in turn as progress rises; a walker retraces finished dragons with time.

styles.name: sierpinski-carpet
styles.description: A row of square Sierpinski carpets: each starts solid, has its centre ninth punched out, then the centre of every remaining ninth, filling in turn as progress rises while a glint sweeps across them with time.

styles.name: burning-ship
styles.description: Burning Ship fractal (z → (|Re z|+i|Im z|)² + c), zoomed onto the little ship near c ≈ −1.76 that gives the set its name: hull on the waterline, masts and rigging rising above — a convoy of them sails in as progress rises, flames flickering with time

styles.name: pythagoras-tree
styles.description: Pythagoras trees: a trunk square carries a right triangle whose two legs carry two smaller squares, and so on — a row of trees each branching level by level as progress reaches it, their crowns swaying gently with time

styles.name: newton-fractal
styles.description: Newton's method on z³−1: each cell is coloured by the cube root it converges to and dotted in convergence-speed bands, so the three basins meet in chains of beads; more of the plane resolves as progress raises the step budget, and the plane turns with time.

styles.name: cantor-dust
styles.description: The Cantor set as its textbook ladder: a full bar, then thirds, ninths, 27ths and 81sts stacked beneath it, each level drawing in as progress rises while a highlight sweeps the surviving dust with time.

styles.name: lyapunov-bar
styles.description: Markus–Lyapunov fractal for the logistic map driven by the sequence AB (a across, b up, both in [3, 4]): stable regions with negative exponent are lit, forming the classic swallow-tail shapes, swept in left to right by progress as the window drifts with time.

styles.name: lorenz
styles.description: Lorenz butterfly attractor (σ=10 ρ=28 β=8/3) seen in the x–z plane: the orbit loops round both wings as progress lengthens it, and the view swings about the z axis with time

styles.name: rossler
styles.description: Rössler attractor (a=b=0.2, c=5.7) seen from above and a little to the side: the orbit winds outward round a tilted spiral band, then lifts into the fold-over lobe and drops back to the centre; progress lengthens the orbit, time turns the view

styles.name: clifford
styles.description: Three Clifford attractors (x′=sin ay+c·cos ax, y′=sin bx+d·cos by) from classic parameter sets, each densifying from a sprinkle into its swirling filaments as progress reaches it; parameters breathe with time

styles.name: de-jong
styles.description: Three Peter de Jong attractors (x′=sin ay−cos bx, y′=sin cx−cos dy) from classic parameter sets, densifying into their folded ribbons one after another with progress; parameters breathe with time

styles.name: henon
styles.description: Hénon map (a=1.4, b=0.3): the boomerang-shaped strange attractor with its parallel folded bands, densifying from scattered points as progress iterates it; a breathes with time

styles.name: logistic-bifurcation
styles.description: Logistic-map bifurcation diagram: r runs 2.8→4.0 left to right, the long-run values of x stacked up each column — one branch forks into 2, 4, 8 and dissolves into chaos, with the period-3 window near r≈3.83; progress sweeps r, time stirs the chaos

styles.name: double-pendulum
styles.description: A real double pendulum (two rods, two bobs) swinging chaotically from a pivot that rides along the top rail with progress, the lower bob trailing its recent path

styles.name: standard-map
styles.description: Chirikov–Taylor standard map phase portrait (θ across, p up): a fan of orbits traces wavy KAM curves and island chains, and as progress raises K from 0.3 to 1.4 the curves break up into a chaotic sea; the portrait scrolls in θ with time

styles.name: gingerbreadman
styles.description: Gingerbreadman map (x′=1−y+|x|, y′=x) from (−0.1, 0): the orbit fills the chunky hexagonal gingerbread-man silhouette, densifying as progress iterates it

styles.name: duffing
styles.description: Duffing oscillator phase portrait (ẏ=−δy+αx−βx³+γcos ωt): the forced orbit loops round both potential wells, its trace lengthening with progress

styles.name: tinkerbell
styles.description: The Tinkerbell attractor (x′=x²−y²+ax+by, y′=2xy+cx+dy; a=0.9 b=−0.6013 c=2 d=0.5): its looping wand-trail shape densifies as it travels along the bar with progress

styles.name: fourier-square
styles.description: Fourier square-wave synthesis: Gibbs ringing grows visible as harmonics unlock with progress

styles.name: fourier-sawtooth
styles.description: Fourier sawtooth synthesis: each harmonic adds a finer diagonal ramp until the teeth appear

styles.name: fourier-triangle

styles.name: epicycle

styles.name: lissajous

styles.name: standing-wave

styles.name: interference

styles.name: phyllotaxis
styles.description: Sunflower phyllotaxis: seeds appear at the golden angle 137.5°, radius ∝ √n, producing the mesmerising Fibonacci spiral pattern of real sunflowers and pinecones

styles.name: cardioid
styles.description: Cardioid: chords from point i to 2·i on a circle appear one by one while the heart-shaped envelope they converge on, (2e^{iθ}+e^{2iθ})/3, traces itself out as progress rises — a row of panels drawing in turn

styles.name: astroid
styles.description: Astroid (4-cusp hypocycloid): x=R·cos³θ, y=R·sin³θ — a star-shaped curve with four sharp cusps that sweeps closed as progress completes a full 2π revolution

styles.name: lemniscate
styles.description: Lemniscate of Bernoulli: the ∞ figure-eight (x²+y²)²=a²(x²−y²), traced with the rational parametric form — both lobes materialise symmetrically as progress sweeps 0→2π

styles.name: maurer-rose
styles.description: Maurer rose: points of the rose r=cos(5θ) at 71° steps joined by straight chords, the first 36 chords weaving a star web in each of a row of panels as progress rises

styles.name: mystic-rose
styles.description: Mystic rose: every pair of vertices of a regular pentagon joined by a chord — the pentagon and its inscribed pentagram, ten chords appearing one by one as progress rises, across a row of panels

styles.name: fermat-spiral

styles.name: value-noise-fill
styles.description: Bilinear value noise lattice thresholded by progress — blobs of filled dots that slowly churn and spread as progress grows.

styles.name: fbm-contour
styles.description: Fractal Brownian motion fill: octave count rises with progress, so the bar starts smooth and gains turbulent detail as it nears 100%.

styles.name: gradient-noise-fill

styles.name: domain-warp
styles.description: Domain warping — sampling fBm at displaced coordinates — produces hypnotic, swirling tendrils that churn and grow with progress.

styles.name: flow-field

styles.name: signal-arc
styles.description: Wi-Fi signal fan: a source dot under three concentric arcs; arcs light from the innermost out, the arc being earned sweeps on left→right with a blinking tip, and unearned arcs wait as dim dotted ghosts

styles.name: compass
styles.description: Compass rose: a full circle with N/E/S/W tick marks and a bearing needle that points to eased × 360° — progress literally steers the heading

styles.name: vu-needle
styles.description: Analog VU-meter needle: the needle bounces rhythmically around the eased level driven by ctx.time, mimicking the momentum of a real moving-coil meter in a recording studio

styles.name: segmented-ring
styles.description: Discrete LED-style segments arranged around a full ring: each is a short arc of dots separated by a small gap; segments light up clockwise from 12 o'clock one by one as eased rises

styles.name: dual-gauge
styles.description: Two concentric arc gauges: the outer ring tracks eased progress while the inner ring oscillates with time, showing a secondary live reading (e.g. instantaneous vs. average) in the same braille dial

styles.name: clock-face
styles.description: Analog clock face: progress maps the full 12-hour cycle — hour hand completes one revolution at 100%, minute hand moves 12× faster, giving a two-hand clock whose time equals eased × 12:00

styles.name: pressure-dial
styles.description: Pressure gauge with a hatched danger arc beyond 75% and a needle that overdamps into place — slow creep at low pressure, urgent quiver at high; danger zone fills with a dense dot pattern when eased exceeds the threshold

styles.name: altimeter
styles.description: Aviation altimeter: ten rim ticks like the 0–9 altitude scale, a long needle spinning 10 revolutions over the full range (hundreds) and a short needle making a single revolution (thousands)

styles.name: radar-scope
styles.description: Radar scope: concentric range rings with a sweep beam rotating on ctx.time; contact blips at pseudo-random bearings appear one by one as eased rises — at 100% the screen is full of traffic

styles.name: attitude-horizon
styles.description: Artificial horizon (attitude indicator): the horizon line climbs the bezel as eased rises — ground hatching shrinks away below — while a gentle time-driven roll banks the whole horizon; fixed wings mark centre

styles.name: bubble-level
styles.description: Spirit level spanning the full width: a gently curved vial with centre marks; the bubble starts at the far end and drifts toward dead centre as eased approaches 1 — level achieved at 100%

styles.name: edgewise-meter
styles.description: Edgewise panel meter spanning the full width: a horizontal scale with ticks every 10% and a hatched red zone past 85%; a slanted needle pivots from below the panel to the eased position, like rack-mount audio gear

styles.name: dial-bank
styles.description: A bank of three mini speedometers side by side: progress cascades — the first dial sweeps 0–33%, the second 33–66%, the third 66–100% — like a rack of instruments coming alive one by one

styles.name: galvanometer
styles.description: Laboratory galvanometer: the needle hangs from a pivot at the TOP of the instrument and swings across an arc scale at the bottom — the inverted geometry of a mirror galvanometer, with a slow critically-damped settle toward the eased deflection

styles.name: anemometer
styles.description: Anemometer in side view: a mast with a footing, three hemispherical cups on a spinning rotor whose speed tracks eased, and wind streaks blowing across the strip that thicken and quicken with progress

styles.name: citrus-wheel
styles.description: Row of orange wheels — rind and eight juicy segments — filling segment by segment

styles.name: apple-bite
styles.description: Row of red apples with stems and leaves, eaten bite by bite down to their cores

styles.name: banana-peel
styles.description: Curved yellow banana peeled from the tip as progress grows; peel flaps dangle and sway

styles.name: grape-bunch
styles.description: Swaying grape bunches on stems; grapes ripen purple one by one as progress grows

styles.name: watermelon-slice
styles.description: Half-moon watermelon slices with green rind and seeded red flesh, filling one by one

styles.name: strawberry-seeds
styles.description: Row of strawberries with leafy green tops, ripening red and seeded from tip to shoulder

styles.name: pineapple-lattice
styles.description: Pineapple on its side: crosshatched gold skin ripens left to right under a swaying leaf crown

styles.name: cherry-swing
styles.description: Row of swinging cherry pairs on joined stems, ripening red one pair at a time

styles.name: juice-squeeze
styles.description: Lemon half squeezed flat over a glass that fills with juice; drips fall and spent rinds pile up

styles.name: berry-pop
styles.description: Crowned blueberries pop into a row one by one, the newest bouncing as it lands

styles.name: kiwi-rings
styles.description: Row of kiwi halves — brown skin, green flesh, seed ring and pale core — cut open one by one

styles.name: seedling
styles.description: Seeds in a soil bed sprout left to right: a hooked shoot straightens and opens two swaying seed leaves

styles.name: fern-fiddlehead
styles.description: A fern fiddlehead unrolls from a tight coil into an open frond as progress advances

styles.name: bamboo-shoot
styles.description: Bamboo culm grows segment by segment upward; joints appear at each node as progress rises

styles.name: ivy-trellis
styles.description: Ivy winds left to right across a wooden diamond-lattice trellis, sprouting fluttering three-lobed leaves

styles.name: cactus-arms
styles.description: Three saguaro cacti rise in turn, sprout elbowed arms and a pink crown flower while a tumbleweed rolls by

styles.name: sunflower-seeds
styles.description: A row of sunflowers opens left to right: yellow petals ring a brown disc packed with spiral seeds

styles.name: mushroom-cap
styles.description: Red spotted toadstools pop up left to right: a cream stalk rises, then the domed cap swells and puffs spores

styles.name: succulent-rosette
styles.description: A potted echeveria fans open: plump sage-green leaves with pink tips spread outward from the centre

styles.name: root-system
styles.description: Soil cutaway under a sprout: cream roots snake right through speckled earth, forking rootlets with wriggling tips

styles.name: bonsai
styles.description: A bonsai in a terracotta pot: the twisting trunk grows, branches reach out and cloud-pad foliage swells

styles.name: galloping-horse
styles.description: Chestnut horse in side profile galloping right — ears, muzzle, flying tail, legs cycling stretch-gather and kicking up dust

styles.name: butterfly
styles.description: Monarch butterfly with big upper and lower wings flapping open and shut as it flutters right over a dotted flight path

styles.name: spider-web
styles.description: Eight-legged spider spinning a silver orb web — it lays the spokes first, then walks the rings round as progress fills

styles.name: beehive
styles.description: Hexagonal honeycomb filling with amber honey cell by cell while two striped bees buzz loops around the front

styles.name: peacock-fan
styles.description: Blue peacock with a crested head raising its train — eye-spotted feathers fan wider and fuller as progress grows

styles.name: leaping-frog
styles.description: Bug-eyed frog croaking on a lily pad, then leaping pad to pad across the pond with legs outstretched

styles.name: octopus
styles.description: Domed octopus with two eyes and six curling tentacles waving below as it jets right, bubbles trailing

styles.name: owl
styles.description: Tufted owl with big ringed amber eyes and a beak, sidling along a branch and blinking

styles.name: murmuration
styles.description: Starling murmuration — a dense, shape-shifting cloud of birds that swells, twists and pinches as it sweeps right

styles.name: elephant
styles.description: Grey elephant plodding right — domed back, flapping ear, ivory tusk, swinging trunk and four pillar legs

styles.name: bat-swoop
styles.description: Big-eared bat beating its scalloped wings as it swoops right past a full moon under twinkling stars

styles.name: mandala
styles.description: Lotus mandala: a ringed six-petal lotus turns slowly at the centre while a border of rosettes and diamonds unrolls symmetrically outward as progress rises.

styles.name: celtic-knot
styles.description: Celtic interlace: two outlined ribbons twist between border rules, each passing over then under the other — the lower ribbon breaks at every crossing; the knotwork extends rightward as progress rises and slowly flows with time.

styles.name: aztec-fret
styles.description: Aztec/Maya stepped fret (xicalcoliuhqui): bold staircase-and-spiral units, alternately mirrored, are laid between border bands from left to right as progress rises; a glint of light sweeps across the finished stone.

styles.name: islamic-star
styles.description: Islamic geometric: eight-pointed interlaced stars ({8/3} star polygons around a ring) bloom into place one after another along a linked chain as progress rises; the rings breathe and the stars glimmer with time.

styles.name: greek-key
styles.description: Greek key / meander: one unbroken squared line climbs and spirals inward again and again between two border rules; it is drawn in from the left as progress rises and slowly travels along the band with time.

styles.name: seigaiha
styles.description: Japanese seigaiha (blue ocean waves): fans of concentric arcs overlap like fish scales, each row tucked behind the one below; scales are laid in from the left as progress rises and the sea drifts gently with time.

styles.name: totem-pole
styles.description: Totem poles: a row of carved poles — stacked faces with hollow eyes, crowned by a thunderbird or a bear — rises one by one from the ground as progress climbs; the thunderbirds beat their wings with time.

styles.name: runes
styles.description: Norse Elder Futhark runes: angular rune-staves are chiselled stroke by stroke into a stone band, in futhark order, as progress rises; sparks flicker at the chisel point.

styles.name: paisley-swirl
styles.description: Paisley (boteh): teardrop motifs with a curled tip and an inner eye are traced one after another, alternately mirrored, as progress rises; each sways gently on its base with time.

styles.name: kente-weave
styles.description: Kente cloth: narrow strips of gold, green and red blocks — weft bars, warp stripes, checks and solid panels — are woven one by one and laid side by side as progress rises; a shuttle darts across the strip on the loom.

styles.name: paper-lanterns
styles.description: Paper lanterns: round red lanterns with gold caps and tassels hang from a sagging festival string; each glows alight from the bottom up in turn as progress rises, and they sway and flicker with time.

styles.name: supernova
styles.description: Supernova shockwave shell explodes outward; radius = eased * max; debris halos outside

styles.name: pulsar
styles.description: Pulsar: neutron star spins twin lighthouse beam cones; a radio pulse trace below records ticks out to eased

styles.name: nebula-clouds
styles.description: Nebula: billowing dithered gas cloud with a dark dust lane and twinkling newborn stars; lit extent = eased

styles.name: big-bang
styles.description: Big-bang singularity explodes: all particles radiate outward, position scales with eased

styles.name: solar-flare
styles.description: Solar flare: a plasma loop with racing knots arches off the Sun's curved limb; loop height and span = eased

styles.name: aurora-curtains
styles.description: Aurora curtains: vertical sine-sheet columns ripple via time; extent = eased

styles.name: meteor-shower
styles.description: Meteor shower: bright-headed streaks with tapering tails rain across the stars; count and horizon fill with eased

styles.name: total-eclipse
styles.description: Total eclipse: the dark Moon slides across the round Sun; corona streamers flare out at totality

styles.name: grav-lens
styles.description: Einstein ring arc: background dots deflect around a central mass; ring radius = eased

styles.name: cosmic-web
styles.description: Cosmic web: node galaxies connected by filaments appearing as eased grows; nodes pulse

styles.name: redshift
styles.description: Redshift: a receding spiral galaxy's light wave stretches toward the observer; spectral line slides redward with eased

styles.name: quasar-jet
styles.description: Quasar: edge-on accretion disc around a blazing nucleus fires twin jets with streaming knots; jet length = eased

styles.name: phone-battery
styles.description: Smartphone battery outline fills with charge; lightning bolt pulses

styles.name: wifi-connect
styles.description: WiFi arcs pulse outward while connecting, then lock solid at 100%

styles.name: bluetooth-pair
styles.description: Bluetooth rune glyph at center; handshake blips pulse outward while pairing

styles.name: disk-defrag
styles.description: Disk defrag cluster map: scattered hollow fragments ahead of the sweep, packed solid clusters behind it, with a blinking read/write head

styles.name: crt-power-on
styles.description: CRT power-on: bright center line expands vertically to fill the screen

styles.name: dialup-modem
styles.description: Dial-up modem: chaotic noise waveform settles to a clean carrier tone as progress rises

styles.name: vinyl-spin
styles.description: Vinyl record: a grooved black disc with a paper label spins up on the turntable while the tonearm tracks inward and a playback timeline fills

styles.name: drone-props
styles.description: Quadcopter seen from above: body, four arms and rotor rings whose blades spin up with progress as the drone flies across

styles.name: activity-ring
styles.description: Smartwatch activity rings: concentric red, green and blue circles close clockwise as progress grows, with matching summary bars

styles.name: usb-transfer
styles.description: USB transfer: file packets stream from the USB trident logo into a flash drive's plug; the drive fills with progress, LED blinking

styles.name: gear-train
styles.description: Gear train: a row of meshed toothed gears, large and small; progress engages them one by one (idle gears ghosted) and engaged gears counter-rotate

styles.name: eink-refresh
styles.description: E-reader page turn: the screen flashes full black, then white, then a new page of text lines appears; the location bar fills with progress

styles.name: barrel-tube
styles.description: A hollow wave pitches its lip over a crouched surfer; the barrel rides right with progress, whitewater behind

styles.name: swell-lines
styles.description: Corduroy swell lines roll in from the horizon in perspective, filling across the sea with progress

styles.name: surfer-carve
styles.description: A surfer on a board rides right with progress, carving an S-shaped wake and throwing spray off the tail

styles.name: wipeout
styles.description: A surfer goes over the falls: legs up in the whitewater, board cartwheeling overhead, foam advancing with progress

styles.name: cutback
styles.description: A surfer whips back toward the curl, throwing a rooster tail of spray; the turn moves right with progress

styles.name: offshore-spray
styles.description: Offshore wind feathers a plume of spray back off a steep wave's crest as it rolls right with progress

styles.name: noseride
styles.description: A longboarder hangs ten on the nose of a long board, trimming right with progress and leaving a wake

styles.name: aerial-launch
styles.description: A crouched surfer boosts off a wave lip into the air and lands, launching further along with progress

styles.name: tide-line
styles.description: The tide floods up a sloping sand beach with progress while lacy swash foam runs up and slides back

styles.name: palm-sunset
styles.description: A swaying palm tree on a sand spit while a striped sun sinks into the sea with progress, reflection shimmering

styles.name: wave-sets
styles.description: Sets of three curling breakers, biggest first, roll in across the bar as progress grows

styles.name: surf-van
styles.description: A two-tone surf bus with a longboard on the roof rack drives right with progress, wheels spinning

styles.name: drag-tree
styles.description: Drag-race Christmas tree: amber lamp pairs light top-to-bottom, then GREEN fires and the staged dragster launches down the strip

styles.name: tachometer
styles.description: Tachometer: a round ticked dial whose needle sweeps idle→redline, a thick redline arc, a flashing SHIFT lamp and an RPM digit readout

styles.name: fuel-gauge
styles.description: Fuel gauge: a round E→F dial whose needle rises with progress, beside a fuel-pump icon that blinks as the low-fuel light below 15%

styles.name: lap-circuit
styles.description: Oval track: a car dot circuits the loop; lap fraction = eased; ghost car trails behind

styles.name: pit-stop
styles.description: Race car up on jacks while the pit crew pulls and bolts on fresh tyres; the pit board ticks off four tyres as progress

styles.name: gear-shifter
styles.description: H-pattern gear shifter: stick hops 1→6 through the gate as progress grows

styles.name: odometer
styles.description: Odometer: framed number drums count 00000→99999 with progress; the last drum rolls smoothly, each digit sliding up as the next rolls in

styles.name: tunnel-headlights
styles.description: Perspective tunnel: converging road lines; headlight beams widen as the car approaches

styles.name: burnout
styles.description: Race car on the start line spinning its rear wheel; billowing tyre smoke and rubber marks reach back further as progress grows

styles.name: pistons
styles.description: Engine cutaway: pistons pump on connecting rods from a spinning crankshaft with spark flashes; more cylinders fire as progress grows

styles.name: nitro-boost
styles.description: Race car rockets along on a flickering nitro flame jet from its exhaust, speed lines streaming past; its position is the progress

styles.name: checkered-flag
styles.description: Checkered flag: a black-and-white chequered flag on a pole unfurls with progress and ripples in the wind

styles.name: charge-and-fire
styles.description: Side-on laser cannon: its charge meter fills and the beam it fires reaches across, sparking at the tip

styles.name: scanning-line
styles.description: Vertical beam sweeps back and forth; swept fraction fills to eased

styles.name: security-grid
styles.description: Corridor of emitter posts with red tripwires criss-crossing between them; bays disarm to green with progress

styles.name: prism-dispersion
styles.description: A white beam strikes a glass prism and fans out as a red-to-violet spectrum that reaches across with progress

styles.name: laser-light-show
styles.description: Concert laser rig: stage projectors throw sweeping fans of coloured beams; more projectors fire with progress

styles.name: range-finder
styles.description: Laser range finder pings a crosshair target that stands further away with progress, over a distance ruler

styles.name: mirror-bounce
styles.description: A beam ricochets between hatched mirrors on the ceiling and floor, reaching further down the chain with progress

styles.name: fiber-pulse
styles.description: Curving optical fiber: light zigzags down the core by total internal reflection, lit up to progress

styles.name: plasma-bolt
styles.description: A plasma-ball electrode discharges a forked lightning bolt that re-strikes each frame; reach = progress

styles.name: particle-accelerator
styles.description: Synchrotron ring with magnets: the energised arc grows with progress as a particle bunch laps ever faster

styles.name: disco-fan
styles.description: Radial fan of beams sweeps from a corner; beam count and arc = eased

styles.name: vesica-piscis
styles.description: Two circles overlap to reveal the sacred lens; arc segments appear with eased progress

styles.name: seed-of-life
styles.description: Seed of Life: a row of seeds, each seven equal circles — one centre and six around it, every one passing through the centre — set circle by circle and seed by seed as progress rises, slowly turning

styles.name: flower-of-life
styles.description: Flower of Life lattice: equal circles on a hexagonal grid, each through its neighbours' centres, blooming left to right as a drifting frieze

styles.name: egg-of-life
styles.description: Egg of Life: a row of seed clusters, each seven touching spheres — one centre, six around, highlighted and swaying in 3-D — set sphere by sphere and cluster by cluster as progress rises

styles.name: fruit-of-life
styles.description: Fruit of Life: a row of thirteen-circle fruits — a centre, six around and six beyond along the hexagonal axes, never touching — each set ring by ring as progress rises

styles.name: metatrons-cube
styles.description: Metatron's Cube: a row of cubes, each the 13 Fruit-of-Life node circles joined into outer hexagon and great hexagram, drawn family by family and cube by cube as progress rises, slowly turning

styles.name: germ-of-life
styles.description: Germ of Life: a row of seven-circle germs — the six-petal flower cut cut by six circles centred on a ring, a seed at its heart and the circle centres marked — petal by petal as progress rises

styles.name: tripod-of-life
styles.description: Tripod of Life: a row of three mutually overlapping circles turning about their shared centre, a three-arm spoke joining their centres — circle by circle and tripod by tripod as progress rises

styles.name: tree-of-life
styles.description: Kabbalistic Tree of Life laid on its side: 10 sephirot on three pillars, the 22 paths drawn crown to kingdom with progress while the lightning flash runs the sephirot in order

styles.name: 64-tetra-grid
styles.description: 64-tetrahedron grid: the lattice seen down its axis as a row of edge-sharing hexagons, each filled with a star tetrahedron (two interlocking triangles), its axes and core — tile by tile with progress

styles.name: torus-flower
styles.description: Torus flower: a row of tori, each eight tube circles rotated about an open centre into a ring, turning with time — circle by circle and torus by torus as progress rises

styles.name: tetrahedron
styles.description: Tetrahedron — the fire solid: 4 vertices and 6 edges assembling as progress grows, spinning on time

styles.name: cube
styles.description: Hexahedron — the earth solid: 8-vertex cube with 12 edges revealed face-by-face as progress grows

styles.name: octahedron
styles.description: Octahedron — the air solid: 6-vertex double-pyramid with 12 equilateral-triangle edges spinning on time

styles.name: dodecahedron
styles.description: Dodecahedron — the aether solid: 20 golden-ratio vertices and 30 pentagonal edges spinning and assembling

styles.name: icosahedron
styles.description: Icosahedron — the water solid: 12 golden-ratio vertices forming 30 equilateral-triangle edges, spinning on time

styles.name: merkaba
styles.description: Merkaba (star-tetrahedron): two interlocked tetrahedra counter-rotating — the light-body vehicle of sacred geometry

styles.name: star-octangulum
styles.description: Stella octangula: two tetrahedra dual to each other inscribed in an octahedron — eight triangular spikes, one rotation axis

styles.name: cuboctahedron
styles.description: Cuboctahedron — vector equilibrium / Metatron's core: 12 vertices at edge-midpoints of a cube, 8 triangles and 6 squares

styles.name: nested-solids
styles.description: Nested duals: a cube spinning inside its dual octahedron — both rotating at different rates, revealed in two waves

styles.name: stellated-dodecahedron
styles.description: Great stellated dodecahedron {5/2, 3}: the dodecahedron's 20 vertices joined by 30 long edges into twelve interlocking pentagrams — a spinning star

styles.name: unfolding-net
styles.description: Cube net: a cross-shaped flat net folds progressively into a 3-D cube as progress advances — geometry becoming solid

styles.name: sri-yantra
styles.description: Sri Yantra: square gate with four doors, enclosing circle, and the interlocking Shiva (up) and Shakti (down) triangles laid one by one around a pulsing bindu, flanked by a progress path

styles.name: lotus-mandala
styles.description: Lotus mandala: eight pointed outer petals and eight inner petals around a seed-pod ring, opening petal by petal and slowly turning between two progress paths

styles.name: rose-window
styles.description: Rose windows: a row of Gothic roses, each a stone rim and hub with eight radiating lancet mullions and a ring of foiled oculi between them, the tracery glazed window by window as progress rises

styles.name: bagua
styles.description: Bagua: the eight I-Ching trigrams in Fu Xi order (☰ ☱ ☲ ☳ | ☴ ☵ ☶ ☷), solid and broken bars appearing one by one either side of a turning yin-yang

styles.name: enneagram
styles.description: Enneagram: nine points on a circle, the 9-3-6 triangle and the 1-4-2-8-5-7 hexad traced line by line with progress, a spark running the hexad's cycle

styles.name: rangoli
styles.description: Rangoli kolam: a row of kolams, each a diamond of nine pulli dots with a loop drawn around every dot by a travelling pen, then framed in a diamond border, kolam after kolam as progress rises

styles.name: chartres-labyrinth
styles.description: Chartres labyrinth: the cathedral floor labyrinth seen in perspective — nested circuit walls with their turning gaps — while a walker traces the single path circuit by circuit to the centre, a dotted trail behind and the progress path either side

styles.name: mandala-tessellation
styles.description: Mandala tessellation: a row of edge-sharing hexagonal tiles, each laid out with six spokes, a hexagram and a turning inner hexagon — the tiling fills tile by tile as progress rises

styles.name: dharma-wheel
styles.description: Dharma wheel (Dharmachakra): rim, nave and eight knobbed spokes — the wheel of the law rolling along its path as progress turns it

styles.name: vesica-rosette
styles.description: Vesica rosettes: a row of six-petal compass rosettes, each petal a vesica lens cut by two arcs of the circle's own radius, petals blooming one by one and rosette by rosette as progress rises

styles.name: star-of-david
styles.description: Star of David hexagram: two interlocking equilateral triangles inked edge by edge and slowly turning, on a progress path

styles.name: golden-spiral
styles.description: The true golden spiral: quarter-circle arcs through the 13-8-5-3-2-1-1 Fibonacci squares, traced inward with progress as the rectangle rides a rail and a bead runs the curve

styles.name: golden-rectangle
styles.description: Recursive φ-rectangle subdivision into a square + smaller φ-rectangle — the whirling-rectangles diagram, with each subdivision revealed as progress rises

styles.name: fibonacci-squares
styles.description: Fibonacci squares 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13 growing outward in the whirling layout, the view zooming out to frame each new square as it is inked

styles.name: pentagram
styles.description: Upright pentagram {5/2} in its pentagon (the next star nests in the inner pentagon, scaled 1/φ², once there is room), riding a rail with progress while a glint runs the star's single stroke

styles.name: pentagon-nest
styles.description: Concentric pentagons each scaled 1/φ² smaller, counter-rotating with time — a hypnotic tunnel of five-fold symmetry

styles.name: golden-gnomon
styles.description: Golden triangle and gnomon: a frieze of 36-72-72 golden triangles, each cut into a 36-36-108 gnomon and a smaller golden triangle, which is cut again and again so the pieces whirl inward in a spiral; turns added with progress

styles.name: phi-phyllotaxis-pent
styles.description: Five-fold phyllotaxis: seeds placed at the golden angle but grouped into five symmetric spiral arms, creating pentagonal lattice symmetry with φ spacing

styles.name: nautilus
styles.description: φ-logarithmic nautilus shell: three whorls, each ~2× the last, traced from the outer lip inward with progress, chamber walls every 45° behind the open body chamber

styles.name: golden-angle-rays
styles.description: 21 rays at successive 137.5° golden-angle increments around a hub, each growing longer — the irrational spacing that prevents clustering and produces optimal coverage of the disk

styles.name: dodecagram
styles.description: Dodecagram {12/5}: a frieze of twelve-pointed stars (every 5th vertex of a 12-gon joined, drawn as the star's silhouette); each star is traced point by point along the strip with progress and turns slowly, alternate stars counter-rotating

styles.name: kepler-triangle
styles.description: Kepler triangle: the right triangle with sides 1:√φ:φ and the squares on its sides (areas 1, φ, φ² — Pythagoras becomes φ² = φ + 1), built panel by panel along the strip

styles.name: penrose-p3
styles.description: Penrose P3 rhombus tiling built by Robinson-triangle subdivision: fat (72°) rhombs in outline, thin (36°) rhombs stippled, laid left to right across the strip as the tiling slowly drifts

styles.name: penrose-p2
styles.description: Penrose P2 kite & dart tiling built by Robinson-triangle subdivision: kites in outline, darts stippled, laid left to right across the strip as the tiling slowly drifts

styles.name: sun-pattern
styles.description: Penrose sun: five kites (72-72-72-144°) meeting tip-to-tip at one vertex, laid kite by kite and slowly turning between two progress paths

styles.name: girih-tiles
styles.description: Islamic girih frieze: a row of edge-sharing decagon tiles, each carrying the ten-pointed strapwork star whose points touch every tile edge at its midpoint, meeting the neighbouring star there; tiles are laid left to right with progress and a spark runs round each finished star

styles.name: ammann-bars
styles.description: Ammann bars: the five families of parallel bars that run through every Penrose rhomb tiling, at 72° to one another, each spaced in the never-repeating Fibonacci order of long and short gaps (L/S = φ); a faint rhomb tiling lies beneath, and the families sweep in one after another with progress, sliding slowly with time

styles.name: debruijn-pentagrid
styles.description: de Bruijn pentagrid: five families of evenly spaced parallel lines at 72° to one another, each with its own offset, whose dual is a Penrose tiling; the families are laid one after another across the strip with progress and the grid drifts slowly with time

styles.name: decagon-fractal
styles.description: Decagon fractal: a frieze of self-similar decagons — each holds a ring of ten satellites and a 1/φ²-scaled copy of itself at its heart, which repeats the rule; flakes unfold left to right with progress, rings counter-turning

styles.name: quasicrystal-diffraction
styles.description: Quasicrystal diffraction: a row of 10-fold Bragg-spot patterns (bright centre, two rings of ten spots at radii in φ ratio, the outer ring turned 18°) — the forbidden symmetry that won Shechtman the Nobel prize; patterns expose left to right with progress and their spots twinkle

styles.name: pinwheel-tiling
styles.description: Pinwheel tiling: a 1:2 right triangle substitutes into 5 smaller copies at irrational rotations, filling the plane with triangles at every angle; deflation generations bloom outward as progress rises

styles.name: truchet-quasi
styles.description: Truchet-quasi: Truchet-style arcs on a Penrose rhomb tiling — every tile carries an arc round its corner, and the arcs join across tile edges into unbroken curves that never repeat; tiles are laid left to right with progress, edges faint, and the tiling drifts slowly with time

styles.name: phoenix-rising
styles.description: A crested firebird beats its raised wings and climbs from the embers, trailing a flickering flame tail

styles.name: dragon-flight
styles.description: A horned, bat-winged dragon flaps across breathing a flickering cone of fire over scorched ground

styles.name: hydra-heads
styles.description: A serpent body sprouts a new swaying neck with progress, up to nine snapping dragon heads

styles.name: kraken-depths
styles.description: A goggle-eyed kraken surfaces and swims toward a ship, tentacles writhing below the rolling waterline

styles.name: pegasus-gallop
styles.description: A white winged horse gallops across the sky, legs and feathered wings beating, over a stardust trail

styles.name: medusa-gaze
styles.description: Snake-haired Medusa stares down a line of warriors; her lengthening gaze turns each one to grey stone

styles.name: minotaur-labyrinth
styles.description: Ariadne's red thread winds through a walled labyrinth toward the horned Minotaur in its inner chamber

styles.name: icarus-sun
styles.description: Winged Icarus climbs from the waves toward a blazing sun, shedding more melted feathers the closer he flies

styles.name: cerberus-watch
styles.description: Three-headed Cerberus pads along on its chain, each pointy-eared head bobbing and snapping as it keeps watch

styles.name: valkyrie-ride
styles.description: A winged-helmed valkyrie gallops across the sky on her steed, spear levelled, trailing streaming speed lines

styles.name: yggdrasil-grows
styles.description: The world tree grows from sapling to vast ash: trunk rises, branches fork, a rustling crown widens, roots spread

styles.name: ouroboros
styles.description: A scaled serpent coils around a rotating ring, its open jaws closing on its own tail at 100%

styles.name: trojan-horse
styles.description: The wooden horse rolls on turning wheels toward the towered walls and arched gate of Troy

styles.name: mjolnir-strike
styles.description: Thor's hammer slams down at the edge of a growing rune-stone road, throwing jagged lightning on impact

styles.name: hurricane
styles.description: A spinning cyclone with spiral cloud arms and a red eye tracks along its forecast path

styles.name: tornado
styles.description: A twisting funnel drops from a storm cloud and tears across the ground, scattering debris

styles.name: snow-accumulation
styles.description: Star-shaped snowflakes drift down onto a white drift that rises with progress, burying a wooden fence

styles.name: hailstorm
styles.description: Round ice pellets pelt down from a dark cloud, bounce on impact and pile up white as progress grows

styles.name: rainbow-arc
styles.description: A red-to-violet rainbow arcs from the horizon and sweeps across the sky as progress grows

styles.name: fog-roll-in
styles.description: Dense fog rolls in from the left; the leading edge thickens with a shade-glyph gradient

styles.name: barometer
styles.description: Brass-rimmed pressure dial: a red needle sweeps from the storm cloud to the sun as progress rises

styles.name: wind-sock
styles.description: Red-and-white striped windsock on a pole: it droops in calm air and streams out level as progress rises

styles.name: blizzard-whiteout
styles.description: Wind-driven snow streaks thicken until a cabin and pine trees vanish into whiteout at 100%

styles.name: cumulonimbus
styles.description: A puffy cumulus towers up into an anvil-topped thunderhead, then rain and lightning fall from its base

styles.name: frost-crystals
styles.description: Dendritic frost crystals propagate inward from the edges; branching depth grows with progress

styles.name: thermometer
styles.description: Mercury column rises in a thermometer tube; bulb glows at bottom, tick marks show scale

styles.name: musical-staff
styles.description: Five-line staff with a treble clef; stemmed notes are written left-to-right as progress grows while a playhead lights them in turn

styles.name: piano-keyboard
styles.description: Piano keyboard with black keys in groups of two and three; keys light up left-to-right with progress while a melody presses them

styles.name: metronome
styles.description: Wooden pyramid metronome swinging its weighted pendulum; beat ticks light up to its right as progress grows

styles.name: vinyl-record
styles.description: Turntable with a spinning grooved record and red label; the tonearm's stylus tracks inward and played grooves dim with progress

styles.name: drum-kit
styles.description: Front-on drum kit that assembles piece by piece with progress while a rock groove flashes the kick, snare and cymbals

styles.name: sound-waveform
styles.description: Centered oscillating waveform; amplitude grows with progress, morph sine→saw with time

styles.name: cassette-reels
styles.description: Compact cassette whose spoked reels turn while tape winds from the left pack to the right and the label strip fills with progress

styles.name: conductor-baton
styles.description: Tailcoated conductor whose baton traces the 4/4 beat pattern; eighth notes stream out across the stage as progress grows

styles.name: sheet-scroll
styles.description: Paper scroll of sheet music between two rollers; notes slide past and the paper winds onto the left roll as progress grows

styles.name: tuning-fork
styles.description: Steel tuning fork on its side with buzzing tines; sound-wave arcs ripple out further with progress

styles.name: volume-knob
styles.description: Amp volume knob turning up its 7-to-5 o'clock tick scale with progress, beside a dancing stereo LED meter

styles.name: beat-pulse
styles.description: Concentric rings expanding outward on each beat; ring density grows with progress

styles.name: acoustic-guitar
styles.description: Acoustic guitar with headstock, fretted neck and sound-holed body; a fretting finger slides up the neck with progress while strummed strings ring

styles.name: trumpet
styles.description: Trumpet in profile with flared bell, tubing loop and three piston valves pressing a fanfare; the brass lights from mouthpiece to bell with progress

styles.name: sprint-100m
styles.description: Sprinter strides down a lined track toward a chequered finish; the tape breaks at 100%

styles.name: basketball-arc
styles.description: Spinning basketball arcs toward a backboard, rim and net; it swishes through at 100%

styles.name: soccer-goal
styles.description: Football rolls across the pitch into a goal of posts, crossbar and net; the net billows on the score

styles.name: swimming-laps
styles.description: Freestyle swimmer windmills down a rippling lane under rope floats toward the touchpad wall

styles.name: archery
styles.description: Arrow flies from a strung bow toward a gold-red-blue ringed target; it thuds into the bullseye at 100%

styles.name: bowling
styles.description: Bowling ball rolls down a wooden lane toward a rack of white pins; strike scatters them at 100%

styles.name: darts
styles.description: Three darts fly in turn at a segmented dartboard with red bull and doubles ring; each third of progress lands one

styles.name: high-jump
styles.description: Jumper sprints the run-up, arches over a crossbar between two standards in a flop and lands on the mat

styles.name: weightlifting
styles.description: Lifter hoists a plate-loaded barbell from the floor to locked-out overhead; plates load up with progress

styles.name: tennis-rally
styles.description: Two rackets trade a bouncing ball over the net; the court line paints in as the rally runs

styles.name: cycling-peloton
styles.description: A tight pack of three road cyclists, wheels spinning and legs pedalling, rides the road to the finish

styles.name: steam-train
styles.description: Steam locomotive with cab, boiler, dome and flared stack pulls a tender and coach; connecting rods turn the wheels and smoke streams back

styles.name: airplane-takeoff
styles.description: Side-view airliner with swept wing, tail fin and window band taxis the runway, rotates nose-up and climbs out trailing a contrail; strobe lights and tail beacon blink

styles.name: sailboat-tacking
styles.description: Sloop with hull, mast, mainsail and jib sails right over rolling waves; the sails swing through each tack and the hull bobs

styles.name: subway-map
styles.description: Subway route line: station dots fill as the train marker advances between stops

styles.name: hot-air-balloon
styles.description: Teardrop hot-air balloon with gored envelope, rope-hung basket and flickering burner lifts off and drifts up and right past clouds

styles.name: ferris-wheel
styles.description: Big spoked Ferris wheel turns on an A-frame with cabins hanging level; festoon bulbs on the light strings switch on with progress

styles.name: cable-car
styles.description: Gondola climbs a diagonal cable from valley to peak; support towers mark intervals

styles.name: escalator
styles.description: Escalator between two floors: stepped truss and handrail with steps climbing over time; a rider walks on, rides up and steps off with progress

styles.name: rocket-gantry
styles.description: Rocket fuels beside its gantry, the arms swing clear, and it lifts off

styles.name: ferry-crossing
styles.description: Ferry with hull, two window decks and a funnel crosses between piers; a V wake opens behind, smoke streams back and waves roll

styles.name: bicycle
styles.description: Diamond-frame bicycle with saddle and handlebars rolls right on spoked wheels; spokes spin and the pedal crank turns

styles.name: helicopter
styles.description: Helicopter with bubble cabin, tail boom, tail rotor and skids lifts off a pad and climbs right; the main rotor sweeps and downwash kicks up

styles.name: sword-draw
styles.description: A longsword drawn from a leather scabbard: pommel, grip and gold crossguard pull clear as the steel blade emerges, a glint running its edge

styles.name: bow-draw
styles.description: A wooden longbow drawn back by progress: the stave bends, the string pulls to a point behind a fletched arrow aimed at a target; at 100% the arrow flies

styles.name: castle-build
styles.description: A stone castle — crenellated towers, curtain walls and a gated keep — rises course by course from the ground; blocks drop onto the fresh course and banners fly when complete

styles.name: trebuchet-launch
styles.description: A wooden trebuchet swings its arm as the iron counterweight drops, hurling a boulder along a dotted arc; progress pushes the target flag further downrange

styles.name: shield-charge
styles.description: A row of heater shields, iron outlines filling one by one with heraldic colours around a cross charge; a glint sweeps across the finished shields

styles.name: jousting
styles.description: Two armoured knights on caparisoned horses gallop toward each other with striped lances couched; they close with progress and the lances splinter on impact at 100%

styles.name: drawbridge
styles.description: A wooden drawbridge lowers on iron chains from a crenellated gatehouse, swinging from upright to flat across a rippling moat to the far bank

styles.name: torch-flame
styles.description: A row of wall torches in iron brackets lights one by one; each teardrop flame flickers yellow-orange-red and throws rising sparks

styles.name: potion-brew
styles.description: Corked round-bottom glass flasks fill one by one with red, blue, green and violet potions; bubbles rise through the brew and full flasks glint

styles.name: treasure-chest
styles.description: An iron-banded wooden treasure chest with a gold lock: the domed lid lifts with progress to reveal a glittering heap of gold, sparkles twinkling around it

styles.name: scroll-unroll
styles.description: A parchment scroll unrolls between two rolls with wooden end-caps, revealing lines of handwritten script; the travelling roll turns as it goes

styles.name: portcullis
styles.description: A spiked iron portcullis lattice rattles up into a crenellated stone gatehouse, clearing the arched gateway; torches flicker either side

styles.name: anvil-forge
styles.description: A blacksmith's hammer rises and strikes a red-hot blade on an iron anvil, sparks flying; the blade is beaten longer with progress, cooling to steel behind the glowing tip

styles.name: banner-unfurl
styles.description: A red heraldic banner with a gold stripe unfurls from a tall pole with a gold finial, streaming further with progress and rippling in the wind, its end cut swallow-tail

styles.name: qubit-superposition
styles.description: Qubit levels |0⟩ and |1⟩: a Rabi wave swings between them, collapsing to a solid |1⟩ behind progress

styles.name: bloch-sphere
styles.description: Round Bloch sphere: state arrow tips from |0⟩ to |1⟩ with progress and precesses with time as the sphere travels

styles.name: wavefunction-collapse
styles.description: Wavefunction collapse: |ψ(x)|² spreads as a broad Gaussian then sharpens to a spike at 100%

styles.name: quantum-tunneling
styles.description: Quantum tunneling: wave packet hits a barrier, transmitted amplitude grows with progress

styles.name: harmonic-oscillator
styles.description: QHO eigenstate |ψₙ|² inside its parabolic well; level n climbs the energy ladder with progress

styles.name: particle-in-box
styles.description: Particle in a box: sin²(nπx/L) standing mode — mode n steps up with progress, walls visible

styles.name: spin-precession
styles.description: Spin arrow cones around a vertical B-field axis; the precessing spin travels with progress, tracing a wave behind it

styles.name: energy-levels
styles.description: Energy level diagram: Aufbau filling — electrons populate orbitals from bottom as progress rises

styles.name: decoherence
styles.description: Decoherence: sharp interference fringes wash out to flat noise as entanglement grows

styles.name: quantum-walk
styles.description: Quantum walk on a lattice: twin ballistic peaks race outward from the start site with progress, ripples between

styles.name: electron-buildup
styles.description: Single-electron double-slit: wavelets spread from two slits and particle hits build up interference fringes with progress

styles.name: skyscraper
styles.description: Glass towers top out one by one across a skyline; lit windows twinkle, beacons blink, a crane swings on the tower going up

styles.name: suspension-bridge
styles.description: Red pylons and a sagging main cable; the deck is launched span by span with suspenders, a car crosses, water ripples below

styles.name: gothic-arch
styles.description: Pointed lancet arches rise bay by bay on pinnacled piers, then fill with shimmering stained glass

styles.name: brick-wall
styles.description: Red bricks in running bond are laid one by one, course by course, while a trowel taps the newest brick into its mortar bed

styles.name: pyramid
styles.description: Three stepped sandstone pyramids rise course by course under a desert sun; sunlit and shadowed faces, gold capstone

styles.name: scaffolding
styles.description: Steel standards, ledgers, timber boards and cross braces go up bay by bay, lift by lift; a bucket is hoisted on the newest bay

styles.name: geodesic-dome
styles.description: A triangulated geodesic hemisphere assembles band by band from the base up; light glints across its hubs

styles.name: spiral-staircase
styles.description: Looking down a stairwell: treads are laid along a spiralling brass handrail down to the newel post; the view slowly turns

styles.name: roman-aqueduct
styles.description: Two tiers of round stone arches advance across a river, with the water channel on top flowing as each span is finished

styles.name: classical-column
styles.description: Ionic columns rise drum by drum on a stepped base, gain scrolled capitals, then carry the entablature; sunlight sweeps the marble

styles.name: blueprint
styles.description: Blueprint drafted: graph grid first, then walls, windows, and dimensions

styles.name: tower-crane
styles.description: A lattice tower crane with counterweight and trolley hoists steel beams while the building beside it rises floor by floor

styles.name: colosseum
styles.description: Three tiers of travertine arches under a windowed attic rise left to right, the far end broken in a ruined profile
